name: Customer
definition: A customer account in the debit-card program, uniquely identified by fld001 in tab01.
scope: Customer-level analysis of payment currency, segment membership, transactions and monthly fuel consumption.

name: Customer Segment
definition: Business classification of a customer stored in tab01.fld002. Observed values are KAM, LAM and SME.
scope: Customer segmentation analysis. Construction questions refer to SMEs, which is the 'SME' value.

name: Payment Currency
definition: Currency in which a customer pays, stored in tab01.fld003. Observed values are CZK (Czech koruna) and EUR (euro). The attribute is recorded once per customer, not per transaction.
scope: Customer currency grouping and CZK-paying versus EUR-paying customer comparisons.

name: Gas Station
definition: A fuel retail station, uniquely identified by fld004 in tab02.
scope: Station-level attributes and station location of transactions.

name: Gas Station Country
definition: Country in which a gas station is located, stored in tab02.fld006. Observed values are CZE (Czech Republic) and SVK (Slovakia).
scope: Country-level comparison and filtering of stations and their transactions.

name: Gas Station Segment
definition: Market segment of a gas station stored in tab02.fld002. Observed values are Discount, Noname, Other, Premium and Value for money.
scope: Station segment analysis, including discount and premium station counts.

name: Product
definition: A product sold at gas stations, uniquely identified by fld007 in tab03.

name: Product Description
definition: Human-readable product name or description stored in tab03.fld008; values are free-text Czech/Slovak product labels such as 'Nafta', 'Natural' and 'Diesel'.
scope: Listing or grouping products by their description.

name: Transaction
definition: A single purchase line recorded in tab04, identified by fld009, carrying a date, time, customer, gas station, product, quantity and price.
scope: Transaction-level analysis; the transaction table covers only 2012-08-23 through 2012-08-26.

name: Transaction Date
definition: Calendar date of a transaction, stored as text in tab04.fld010 in YYYY-MM-DD form.
scope: Date and date-range analysis of transactions.

name: Transaction Time
definition: Time of day of a transaction, stored as text in tab04.fld011 in HH:MM:SS form.

name: Transaction Quantity
definition: Number of product units purchased on a transaction line, stored as an integer in tab04.fld013. Observed range is 0 to 264; 91 of 1000 lines have zero quantity.
scope: Volume and quantity aggregation, and the denominator of average unit price.

name: Transaction Price
definition: Monetary price recorded for a transaction line, stored as a real value in tab04.fld014. Observed range is 1.76 to 5762.49.
scope: Spending and price aggregation at transaction-line level.

name: Average Unit Price
definition: Average price paid per single item or unit, defined as the total transaction price divided by the total transaction quantity across the considered scope.
scope: Price-per-item analysis for a customer or transaction set.

name: Customer Spending
definition: Total monetary value of a customer's transactions, obtained by summing transaction prices over that customer's transaction lines.

name: Monthly Fuel Consumption
definition: Fuel consumption attributed to a customer for one calendar month, stored as a real value in tab05.fld015.
scope: Customer monthly and annual fuel consumption analysis over 201112-201311.

name: Year-Month Period
definition: Monthly period key stored as six-character YYYYMM text in tab05.fld010; the first four characters are the year and the last two the month.
scope: Monthly period filtering and aggregation of consumption data.
